what: the inner side wall of the vertical leg of a mitred swept bar extruded outward by 3 mm (the wall is a B-spline net in a plane, "the selected planar face no longer exists")
method: bar: 8 x 5 section, path 30 up then 40 across (mitred): V = 40 * 70 = 2800.
